name: ANSI BBS Art
summary: Pictures and menus made of 80-column text blocks in the 16 ANSI colours: shade characters, box lines and wide logos. Dial-up bulletin boards showed them, and art groups released them in monthly packs.

philosophy.core_thesis: A picture is a grid of characters: every shape must fit an 8 by 16 pixel cell and one of 16 colours.
design_principles: Build the layout on a grid of 80 columns by 25 rows; one cell is 8px wide and 16px high.
Use only the 16 ANSI colours, on a black ground (#000000), and show 8 colours as the dark set and 8 as the bright set.
Shade with block characters: light shade ░ at 25%, medium shade ▒ at 50%, dark shade ▓ at 75%, full block █ at 100%.
Frame menus and windows with double-line box characters ╔ ═ ╗ and keep the frame 1 cell wide.
Set the signature logo 6 to 10 rows high in a block font, with a 3-stop colour fade from dark blue to cyan to white.
Put a status bar of 1 row at the foot of the screen, white on blue, with key hints in brackets.
Blink one cursor block at 530ms; reveal long screens line by line at 1 row per 40ms to imitate a 28.8 kbps modem.
anti_patterns: More than 16 colours on one screen
Free layout that ignores the cell grid

layout.grid_mechanics: A strict grid of 80 columns by 25 rows with 8px by 16px cells; every element snaps to whole cells.
layout.whitespace_ratio: 10% to 20% of the cells stay black; the spacing scale is 1 cell, 2 cells and 1 row (8px, 16px).
layout.alignment_rules: Menus flush left at column 2; logos centred over the full width of 80 columns.
layout.container_geometry: Rectangles of whole cells with a double-line frame; the radius is 0px.

font_pairings.note: VT323 is an open look-alike of a VGA text screen; IBM Plex Mono carries long reading.
A wide pixel face for logos with a mono text face.
A lower-case mono display for a cleaner title.

typography.tracking: Display 0.04em; body 0em, because every glyph fills one cell.
typography.leading: Display 1.0; body 1.25, which gives 16px rows at 16px size.
hierarchy_rules: Use one size, 16px, for all text; make hierarchy with colour and with block logos.
Use bright white for titles and light grey (#AAAAAA) for body text.
Set menu keys in bright yellow and menu labels in light grey.
Use upper case for headings and lower case for body text.

color.palette_structure: Sixteen fixed colours on black: a dark set of 8 and a bright set of 8; use 3 to 4 on one screen.
color.contrast_rules: Light grey on black is 9:1; white on blue is 12:1; dark blue text on black is not allowed.
color.surface_treatment: Flat colour cells with dither by shade characters; no gradient, only steps.
color.light_and_shadow: No light source; depth comes from a dark shade as a shadow of 1 cell on the right and below.

materiality.surface_simulation: A text-mode screen on a CRT: each cell is a glyph with a foreground and a background colour.
materiality.border_rules: A double-line box frame 1 cell wide; a single line for inner panels.
materiality.blur_and_elevation: No blur; a 1-cell shadow in dark grey (#555555) gives elevation.

ornamentation_details.iconography: Icons are glyphs in a cell: ☺ ♥ ♦ ♣ ♠ and arrows, 16px, solid, with square ends.
ornamentation_details.illustration: Logos and scenes drawn with ░▒▓█ and half blocks; skulls, dragons, logos and portraits in 2 to 4 colours.

motion.transition_physics: Screens draw line by line at 25 lines per second; a scroller moves text 1 cell per 80ms; no tweening.
motion.hover_and_active: Hover inverts the cell: swap the foreground and the background colour; focus shows a blinking block at 530ms.

emotion.target_response: The viewer feels the thrill of a secret network and respects the craft of a limit.

use_cases: game and tool launch screens in text mode
avoid_when: The audience needs accessible long reading on small screens.
The brand needs a polished, friendly tone.

modifiers.how: Keep the cell grid and swap the 16 colours for 2 or 3 hues and a quiet line frame.
Add loud acid colour fields and warped logos; leave the grid.
Move to a free page with tiled backgrounds and pixel GIFs.

pack.why: Pixel icons share the square cell of a text-mode screen.

ground.why: The ground is a field of 8 by 16 pixel cells, as on a text-mode screen.
